reading.action: Rename the emergent skill Ember Lash -> EMBER WAVE (player's call). Drill it again and again trying to force the flow into a narrow, focused, intense STREAM instead of a wide burst — practice to focus-exhaustion, then meditate until recovered.
reading.roll: NONE — deterministic drilling montage (anti-grind: skills grade on authorship, not tempo; reps build within-rung competence but cannot cross a rung).
reading.result: RENAME: Ember Lash -> Ember Wave (id ember-lash -> ember-wave); historical t37 ledger line keeps the old name. | PRACTICE (deterministic, anti-grind capped): hard drilling climbs the WITHIN-Novice level via the locked roll-up (level += 0.5*(5-level)): 1 -> 3. He DOES narrow the form — the wild wash tightens toward a rougher controllable STREAM, more aimable than the first throw. But the TIGHT intense lance he wants will NOT come from drilling: it's the counterfeit-band ceiling (clamp at within-rung 4; promotion to Apprentice needs 1 qualifying LIVE demo, not reps). He feels the wall. No rung-up, no System window — a quiet within-rung gain only. | MEDITATION: practiced to focus-exhaustion (Focus drained ~ to empty), then meditated back to recovered. NET pools: Focus 80 -> 78 (-2 net after the drain+recovery arc), Stamina 48 -> 46 (-2, repeated casting). HP unchanged. No affinity tick (skill-use, not absorption). Burning Anger still half-charged (drilling used his own fresh ember, spared the bar's remaining charge). NO Tower reset. PREPARING (floor 3 not attempted).
